agent_review.author: agent

findings.summary: Action 3 attempted slower Spark at 13 HP and Ohmnomnom fainted without acting because the global pivot guard incorrectly vetoed the prepared Lildozer switch.

resolution.observed: Policy v15 restores the two-hit anti-relay bound; exact-state replay selects Lildozer with 20 HP critical-entry margin.

findings.summary: Five Pokémon fainted. Lildozer, Croakatoa, Bushtank, and Bugatti all dealt verified progress before creating free entries, but the next clone must confirm that none becomes a zero-action sacrifice.
At action 17 Bushtank was slower at 8 HP versus Eelektrik 2 HP; Toxic allowed Razor Leaf to execute, while a damaging enemy move would force a different finisher sequence.
The win required 27 decisions; the corrected early Lildozer entry should remove Ohmnomnom's failed turn and reduce the line if later variance is unchanged.

correct_choices: Every replacement after action 3 was a forced entry; there was no switch spam or switch-in-and-switch-out cycle.
Fresh Fake Out was followed by Mud Shot to finish Ponyta.
Croakatoa used executable priority damage before fainting to Eelektrik.
Bugatti stayed against Dustox, made Rollout progress, and gave Birdlaw a damage-free forced entry.
Birdlaw used only Aerial Ace and finished with 32 HP.
agent_review.next_test: Run v15 Clone 1 from the unchanged opening; require Lildozer at action 3, no no-action voluntary switch, and review every faint before any further clone.
